literal: The wealth of compassion is the supreme wealth among all wealth; material wealth exists even with base people.
translation: The wealth of compassion is the supreme wealth among all wealth, for material wealth can be found even among the basest of people.
modern: அருளாகிய செல்வமே செல்வங்கள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் சிறந்த செல்வமாகும்; பொருளாகிய செல்வமோ இழிந்த குணமுடையவர்களிடத்திலும் இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet contrasts inner spiritual wealth with outer material wealth to establish the primacy of compassion. The poet argues that compassion (அருள்) is the greatest treasure one can possess. To prove this, he points out that material wealth (பொருட்செல்வம்) is common and can be acquired even by mean or ignoble individuals (பூரியார்). Because material riches do not require or reflect noble character, they are inferior to the wealth of a compassionate heart, which belongs only to the truly virtuous.
